Results in MSC Group

Improved wound healing, increased wound closure rate, best results in scaffold group. Increased re-epithelialization and increased early neo-angiogenesis. Better healing with less inflammation, scarring and contraction. Increased reepithelialization, better archeology. No infection. Accelerated wound healing and wound closure rate. Less inflammation. Increased re-epithelialization and granulation, regular pattern of regenerated collagen. Accelerated healing process, but longer than non-burn wound group. Increased collagen deposition, granulation, and re-epithelialization. No complications reported. Increased rate of healing, re-epithelialization, granulation. Mature and organized scar tissue, less hemorrhage and inflammation. Increased wound healing and complete epithelialization in both MSC groups, best in A-PCL-WJ-MSC group with complete epidermal restoration and near normal skin appendage
